answer: Hardware attestation bound to identity: each account must present a fresh attestation from a trusted execution environment proving it runs on distinct hardware, and the attestation key is burned into the identity at registration. A glacier of virtual machines cannot fake distinct silicon, because the attestation quotes a hardware counter no hypervisor can clone cheaply. A sonnet of rented cloud cores still shares one attested root, and a juniper of honest devices each pays only the one-time attestation cost.
